title: Evidence capture handoff fixed
details: Photo capture now takes the live 1:1 camera frame directly, removing the long Capturing delay shown on Android
After Use photo, Evia now immediately opens the required written explanation for that photo
After Finish recording, Evia now immediately opens the optional extra-text screen without showing the black media preview or another Continue step
The existing Evia learner UI, guided video prompts, audio recording and prompt timestamps are unchanged
summary: Evia v131 fixes the exact photo and video handoff faults shown in the latest test recording.
changes: Replaced the slow photo frame path with direct live-frame capture
Tied accepted photos directly to their explanation step
Tied finished guided videos directly to optional text
Removed the failed v130 auto-advance approach from the active app
Moved the offline shell to v131
